backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user registration/profile management, feedback submission with star ratings, and admin-only operations (list users, delete users/feedback) with access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (English text conversion, white-accent dark theme, and others) to their affected frontend files, component dependencies, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, styles, and configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes, used as the global stylesheet foundation.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, hero image preload, font preconnects, and canonical URL for the QuickRepair Mahipalpur site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up React Query, implements scroll-spy navigation, lazy-loads all page sections with Suspense fallbacks, and routes between the main site and the admin page based on the URL path.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'Why Choose Us' section with four animated highlight cards (response time, verified experts, fixed pricing, coverage) and a company description panel.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays and manages all registered users and feedback entries, with delete actions and refresh; access is gated by admin role check.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Renders the contact section with phone, email, and hours cards, a service areas list, and a WhatsApp CTA panel.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders an accordion-style FAQ section with nine pre-defined questions and animated expand/collapse per item.
Displays customer reviews fetched from the backend in a grid and provides a form for submitting new star-rated feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Fixed floating button in the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the configured number.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, a WhatsApp booking CTA, and a bottom bar with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top header with logo, desktop nav, scroll-based styling, Internet Identity auth button with user dropdown, and triggers a profile modal when no profile exists.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, animated headline, tagline, WhatsApp and phone CTA buttons, and stat badges for a Mahipalpur car repair service.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Three-step process section (Book, Mechanic Arrives, Problem Solved) with fade-in animated cards and a WhatsApp CTA button at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/LanguagePopup.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with nav links, a 'Become a Mechanic' link, and footer WhatsApp booking and phone contact actions.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: Semi-transparent backdrop overlay component that toggles visibility and triggers a click callback, used to close the mobile navigation drawer.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: Modal form for new authenticated users to complete their profile by entering name, phone, and service area, submitting via the registerUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ScrollLoginPopup: A modal popup that appears after 7 seconds of scrolling for unauthenticated users, prompting them to sign in via Internet Identity with feature highlights and a login button.
frontend/src/components/ScrollRatingPopu: A modal popup shown to authenticated users after 15 seconds of scrolling (once per session) that collects a name, star rating, and message, then submits feedback via the useAddFeedback hook.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a single car repair service card with icon, name, description, price, duration, and a WhatsApp booking link, with a fade-in animation on scroll.
Renders the full services section with a hardcoded list of six car repair services displayed in a responsive grid of ServiceCard components, plus a WhatsApp CTA button.
frontend/src/components/SkeletonLoader.t: A simple reusable skeleton loading placeholder component with a shimmer animation, configurable height and className.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A stats bar displaying four animated count-up metrics (customers, response time, rating, availability) that trigger when the section scrolls into view.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, using the authenticated identity if available or an anonymous actor otherwise, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: A hook that animates a number from 0 to a target value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve, starting only when a trigger flag is true.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element enters the viewport, enabling fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and status tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating feedback data (getAllFeedback, averageRating, feedbackCount, addFeedback), user profile operations (getMyProfile, registerUser), and admin checks, with delayed query initialization for performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by comparing scroll position against section offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollTimer.ts: Custom hook that accumulates elapsed time (in seconds) only while the user is actively scrolling, using requestAnimationFrame and a debounced scroll timeout.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter/Poppins fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines CSS custom properties for the dark theme color system, and declares keyframe animations used throughout the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter/Poppins), oklch-based color tokens, surface shades, brand colors, box shadows, and keyframe animations matching the app's design system.
project_state.json: Project state document describing QuickRepair's features, architecture, business rules (prices, contact info, service areas), and existing feature inventory at schema version 23.
